column1: # Workload for examples/outcomes.cpp and python/examples/outcomes_demo.py (see docs/outcomes-demo.md).
# Tab-separated columns: family, kind, item, text
#   kind = threshold : text is the similarity threshold the caller applies to this family (its starting guess)
#   kind = item      : a value stored with metadata family=<family>, item=<item>
#   kind = query     : a query; item is the stored item that should serve it, or "-" when no stored item does
# The item column of a query is the ground truth the constraint check compares against. A query labelled "-"
# must not be served from the cache: any candidate the similarity gate lets through for it is a false accept.
# Every family starts at a deliberately loose 0.70 so that the gate produces evidence on both sides of the
# threshold it should end up with; the per-family report is what says where that is.
